completed.description: True if the task's stated goal was fully achieved. False if any part was skipped, deferred, or blocked.

committed.description: True if a git commit was made as part of this task.

commit_message.description: The commit message used, or null if no commit was made.

summary.description: One-to-two sentence human-readable description of what changed.

pr_created.description: True if a pull request was created.

pr_url.description: The URL of the created pull request, or null if none was created.

blockers.description: Anything that prevented full completion. Empty if completed cleanly.
